leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the visibility property to show or hide elements while preserving layout space.
Configure the opacity property to adjust an element's transparency level.
Manipulate CSS selectors to control visibility and opacity for specific elements.
Integrate visibility and opacity changes with pseudo-classes like :hover for interactive effects.
Construct a multi-element layout to demonstrate the difference between visibility: hidden and display: none.
Update CSS rules dynamically to toggle element visibility using class changes.
Render a visual example that combines opacity transitions with visibility toggling for smooth fade effects.
